items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: Steve Gadd, Grady would play drums, we’d have all the great players.

ctx.x: That’s wild. And most of those were, at that time, a 60-second commercial was a reality.

Oh yeah. 30’s and 60’s. I mean that was basically it. But you’d have so many meetings. I mean I had more meetings for the 30-second commercial than I’ve had for a record project. It was just nuts. But at the time the hip part about it is at the time that I was getting involved in the studio work it was the transition from one group of players, to the guys like a Steve Gadd and a Will Lees and Randy Brecker and George Youngs and all these, it was like Ronnie Cubers, Jim Pugh, Dave Taylors, we were like the new…
